Mefcom Capital Markets Limited
August 21, 2026
To,
National Stock Exchange of India Limited
Exchange Plaza, Plot No. C/1, G Block,
Bandra Kurla Complex
Bandra (East), Mumbai 400051
Maharashtra, India
Re: Proposed initial public offering of equity shares of face value of ₹ 10 each (the “Equity Shares”) of Rays
of Belief Limited (the “Company” and such offering, the “Issue”)
Dear Madam/Sir,
This is in relation to the Red Herring Prospectus dated August 19, 2026 (the “RHP”) and the abridged prospectus
(“Abridged Prospectus”) filed with Registrar of Companies, NCT of Delhi – I, at South Delhi (“RoC”) and the
Securities and Exchange Board of India, the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on August
19, 2026, in connection with the proposed Issue.
This is to inform you that the Company has published a Corrigendum to the RHP (the “Corrigendum”) dated August
19, 2026 informing potential Bidders the following modifications to the disclosures in the RHP and Abridged
Prospectus:
1. The Designated Stock Exchange as mentioned across the RHP should be read as “NSE” instead of “BSE”
across page numbers i.e., cover pages, 6, and 405 in the RHP and page number i.e., cover page in the Abridged
Prospectus.
The Corrigendum dated August 20, 2026 is published today on August 21, 2026 in all editions of The Financial
Express (a widely circulated English national daily newspaper), all editions of Jansatta (a widely circulated Hindi
national daily newspaper, Hindi also being the regional language of New Delhi, where the Registered Office and
Corporate Office of the company is located) and the same is enclosed herewith as Annexure A.
The Corrigendum shall be read with the RHP and the Abridged Prospectus. We further, undertake to update the
relevant information in Prospectus, as applicable.
You are requested to kindly take the above information on record.
